newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat -Spring wheat sharply down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat -Spring wheat sharply down.

text.p: Most spring wheat values were much weaker on Friday as merchandisers anticipated greater grain movement in the Northern Plains and upper Midwest by this weekend, cash sources said.
"Most people are anticipating a lot more grain coming at them this weekend," said one Montana-based dealer.
Some railroads have said lines closed by recent snows would be plowed and reopened by this weekend, cash sources said.
Other sources of weakness in cash prices included a drop in basis and weakness on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange, sources said.
Traders at MGE reported heavy commercial selling that was said to be linked to producer hedging.
The most active wheat contracts traded on the exchange ended down 2-3/4 to 9 cents per bushel, with March down 9 cents and May down 5-1/2 cents.
